text:
kai: heads-up, promo hold on canary. pipeline build-bundle-staging-881 failed fetching package index: 504 from index service when resolving wheel URI. deploy-bot applied hold.
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-03-29. job=build-bundle-staging-881 exit=1 reason=index-fetch-504
marta: logs show request to https://index.internal/wheels/lookup?name=redwood-serve&ver=2.0.0 -> 504 gateway timeout. downstream S3 calls were fine.
rijan: could be index regen under heavy load after bulk multipart uploads. if index update is slow, runners hit timeouts and fall back to absent artifact. any quick unblock suggestions?
ops: easiest unblock is to re-run the index lookup locally and populate a temporary index entry pointing to the existing wheel key, then retry job. that avoids touching object storage.
ci-bot: command to patch index: `curl -XPOST https://index.internal/admin/patch -d '{"key":"wheels/redwood_serve-2.0.0-py3.whl","etag":"zz99","size":245760}' && deploybot retry build-bundle-staging-881`
kai: do we have admin token for index.admin? I don't.
marta: I can run that. doing patch now.
marta: POST returned 200, temp index entry created. triggering retry: `deploybot retry build-bundle-staging-881`
deploy-bot: retry queued for build-bundle-staging-881. runner=gh-runner-03
ci-bot: build-bundle-staging-881 started on gh-runner-03
ci-bot: index fetch -> 200 OK from temp index, wheel fetch -> 200 OK, pip install succeeded
ci-bot: build-bundle-staging-881 exit=0
deploy-bot: canary promo resumed automatically after job success. Promo status: paused -> queued promote.
release-manager: proceeding with canary promote at 09:45 UTC. leaving a release note: transient index service timeout returned 504 during resolver window; we patched index to unblock build. follow-up: make index admin patch atomic and add alert for index slowness during uploads.
ops: filing INF-678: investigate index regen latency under heavy compose operations; add backpressure and a short-circuit for lookup timeouts with cached pointers.
rijan: adding runbook to eng-releases: on index-fetch-504 during promo hold -> attempt admin patch with existing wheel key, retry job; fallback: pin previous canary image if patching not possible.
kai: thanks all, mark resolved after promote completes :thumbsup:
